description: This file defines the DGet class, which provides functionality for extracting a single value from a database-like data structure based on specified criteria, mimicking Excel's DGET function.

classes.name: DGet
classes.description: A class to implement the DGET function, extracting a specific value from a database based on criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates and retrieves a value from the database that matches the given criteria, similar to the Excel DGET function.
